## Powerful values of quadratic polynomials

Paper 1 uses seven admitted formal interfaces, A1–A4 and A11–A13, in the
[shared registry](registry/consecutive-counting.json). The integrated build,
axiom/type audit, independent release replay and negative control have passed.
The publication manifest selects 29 targets: 22 for Paper 0 and these
seven for Paper 1. The retained shared replay covers 38 interfaces and includes
every selected target; its full scope exceeds the manuscript scope. Paper 1 is intended
for a standalone deposit; admission is a verification status, not publication.

A4 and A11 are supporting verified interfaces, not independent discoveries;
[the prior-art note](verification/consecutive-counting/prior-art.md) distinguishes
them from the headline quadratic improvements.
Paper 1 uses conventional theorem numbering, mapped in its appendix and
[paper guide](PAPERS.md). Its stronger written cubic corollary does not
change the exact formal A4 statement or the scope of the replay receipt.

| Paper | Claims | Mathematical scope | Named formal premises |
|---|---|---|---|
| [1: Powerful values of quadratic polynomials](papers/powerful-polynomial-values/main.pdf) | A1–A4, A11–A13 | Fixed and coefficient-uniform polynomial-value bounds; mixed-full applications with their stated orientations and shifts | Stewart, Castryck–Cluckers–Dittmann–Nguyen, Gelfond |

The [registry](registry/consecutive-counting.json) gives a human-readable summary and the declaration/premise mapping for every
claim; the [independent Lean statement file](replay/statements/consecutive-counting/Statements.lean)
contains the full quantifiers and definitions; [PAPERS.md](PAPERS.md) gives manuscript and
publication status. These conditional statements do not assert that the named
external theorems have themselves been proved in this repository.
